summary.text: 16-year-old male with allergic rhinitis had fever, odynophagia and exudative tonsillitis with a truncal rash; a first streptococcal antigen test and EBV serology were negative and he improved. A week later fever recurred, the streptococcal antigen test was positive and amoxicillin was started. On day nine of amoxicillin a morbilliform exanthem developed, with positive EBV VCA IgM and IgG, and he improved on antihistamine therapy. Oral provocation 10 weeks later reproduced a morbilliform rash, confirming amoxicillin hypersensitivity.
